headline: Bondage mode defaults to player-pick, and late joiners get asked their own questions.
detail:
If nobody answers the bondage-mode question, the game now defaults to player-pick instead of a predefined outfit.
Anyone joining during the pre-game question window gets their own individual pick/outfit question and a toys check, rather than being silently defaulted into whatever the room had already chosen.

headline: Lock-time voting reworked, plus !pause / !resume, prize swapping and safeword changes.
detail:
The end-game lock-time vote was rebuilt, and the safeword flow was reworked alongside it.
Anyone can now call !pause for a quick break; anyone can type !resume to pick the game back up.
Team games can swap prizes between winners, and solo games can capture a prize of their own.

headline: Walking into a game in progress no longer makes you the bondage picker.
detail:
A player who joined a game already underway was being recorded as "never lost" — the same standing as a veteran who had survived the whole game without rolling a 1. Since that is the top-priority signal for being chosen as the picker, someone could walk in and immediately start picking other players' restraints.
Anyone entering mid-game is now stamped as if they had just lost, putting them at the back of the picker order until they have actually played. Nothing changes at game start: the starting roster all begin equal exactly as before, and the "longest without losing gets to pick" rule is otherwise untouched.

headline: You can now friend the bot to see when the room is up, and !changelog shows what's new.
detail:
Friending: BC only shows two people to each other on their friend lists when both have added the other, so adding the bot on its own never did anything. Now, if you use BC's "Add friend with notification" option on the bot, it adds you back automatically — after that the bot appears in your friend list whenever it's online, along with the room name and how many players are in it. The "add without notifying" option sends the bot no signal at all, so if you used that one (or added the bot a while ago), whisper !friend and it'll add you back. !unfriend removes you again at any time. No beeps are sent — this is display only.
Changelog: room chat no longer gets a wall of text after every update. Restarts announce a single headline for the big changes only, and if something shipped while you were away you'll get a one-line nudge on your way in. Whisper !changelog any time for the last few updates in full.

headline: Team mode fix: the whole winning team is now fully unbound at the end — including a teammate who got bound during the game.
detail: Before, if someone on the winning team had been fully bound before their team clinched the win, they were still getting locked at game end like a loser. The bot freed them once, but then re-locked them a moment later when it applied everyone's end-game locks, so they ended up stuck. Now every member of the winning team is stripped and left free, and only the losing team gets locked.

headline: Fixed: prize lock passwords could be wrong. One password now opens everything.
detail:
If you won a game and claimed a prize, the password you were given could fail to open some of their restraints. This happened to Candy claiming Oklin: the bot said the password was OBEDIENT, but several of Oklin's locks were actually set to PLAYFUL, that game's shared password.
The cause: a prize player's restraints were locked twice. First with the game's shared password like everyone else, then locked again a minute later with their own private prize password. Anything that touched a lock in between — or any part of that second pass that didn't land — left them with a mix of both, while !claim only ever knew about the second one.
Now a prize player's own password is decided before a single lock goes on, and every lock they receive uses it from the start, including the collar and leash and any lock the bot has to re-apply. There is no second pass to go wrong, and the password !claim gives you is the only one on them.
Side effects, both good: end-game locking now sends about half as many item updates for prize players, so the whole sequence finishes faster and is less likely to hit Bondage Club's rate limit. And in team games, prize players were being given a shorter lock timer than everyone else because the shared 69-roll bonus was left out of their time — they now get the same duration as the rest of the losing team.

headline: Real life has gotten in the way lately — thank you all for your patience. Updates and fixes are in the works and coming soon! 🎲
Tournament mode is installed and being tested — nothing changes for you yet.
detail:
Tournament support is now on the bot but completely dormant: unless an admin actually starts one, nothing about the room, your games, or your commands behaves any differently. You'll see !tournament in the help only while a tournament is actually running.
The plan is a small test tournament with a few volunteers first, on very short rounds, before anything real is announced. If you'd like to be one of the guinea pigs, say so in the room.
Format, when it does run: Swiss pairing with double elimination. Each round you're paired with someone on a similar record and you each play 3 solo Survive games on your own time — no need to be online together. Most rolls survived wins. Lose twice and you're out. The last two meet in a grand final.

headline: 🔔 New: whisper !bd register, then !looking beeps everyone online when you want a game.
detail:
Matchmaking pool — nobody should have to sit in an empty room hoping someone turns up. Whisper !bd register once (you'll add me as a friend too, which is how beeps reach you), and from then on you get a beep whenever someone is here looking for a game.
When YOU are the one waiting, whisper !looking and I'll beep every registered player who's online right now, telling them you're here. If any of them reply to that beep, I pass their reply straight back to you.
!bd pause and !bd resume turn the beeps off and on without leaving the pool; !bd unregister leaves it entirely; !bd status shows where you stand. Whisper !bd for the full list.
Two house rules: !looking has a 30-minute cooldown so the pool doesn't get spammed, and please stay in the room for at least 3 minutes after calling it — people need time to see the beep and travel over. Walking straight back out after calling wastes everyone's beep, and doing it repeatedly drops you from the pool.
Also on this update: solo games now offer you last game's outfit instead of asking about every item again, the same way !same works in a multiplayer game. Reply 1 to reuse it or 2 to go through the list.
And: tournament mode is installed but dormant. Unless an admin actually starts one, nothing about the room, your games, or your commands behaves differently — !tournament only appears in the help while a tournament is genuinely running. A small test tournament with volunteers comes first, on very short rounds. Format when it does run: Swiss pairing with double elimination — each round you're paired with someone on a similar record, you each play solo Survive games on your own time, most rolls survived wins, lose twice and you're out.
